scale_framework.subject: An elderly Tamil patriot in a crisp, hand-spun off-white Khadi veshti and angavastram, conversing with a young lawyer wearing a traditional Madras cotton pattu border mundu and spectacles, reviewing handwritten freedom pamphlets on a wooden desk.

lighting.quality: Soft directional golden rays streaming through wooden window louvers

environment.place: A traditional Mylapore 1940s Madras house with pillared thinnai (veranda), Athangudi terracotta floor tiles, and exposed teak wood rafters
